hook: Setty, sitting on a diner table next to the napkin dispenser, to the coach in the booth at 1 a.m., phone in hand behind a huge order: You let a [bleep]ing hot lead sleep on it, right?
biais: autorité (une étude, un chercheur nommé : Loewenstein, 2005)
écart de curiosité (« there's a name for it »)
pertinence pour soi (son lead chaud de la semaine, « tonight »)
ancrage dans le décor (il vit l'étude de la faim en direct)

sources.fait: Psychologists call it the hot-cold empathy gap. When we're calm, we underestimate how much a strong feeling drives our choices; in the moment, we think we'll feel the same tomorrow.
sources.source: Loewenstein, G. (2005), Health Psychology 24(4 Suppl.), S49-S56, doi:10.1037/0278-6133.24.4.S49 (00_STRATEGIE/sources/banque-2.md, idée 20, L1 et L3)

sources.fait: In one study, hungry people picked more junk food for next week than people who had just eaten.
sources.source: Read, D. et van Leeuwen, B. (1998), Predicting hunger, OBHDP 76(2), 189-205, doi:10.1006/obhd.1998.2803 (banque-2.md, idée 20, L5)

sources.fait: Aucune étude ne porte sur des leads en DM : lecture par analogie, sans durée ; l'oubli (rd84) reste une autre cause.
It asks one question at a time, offers two or three open times in the lead's time zone and books on Cal.com, Calendly or iClosed; on Calendly Free or another tool it sends the booking link.
sources.source: banque-2.md, faits produit P6, P9, P9b (site ManySetter, commit 4437fc1)
